'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[Gaza war]]

**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Lebanon war]]
****Israeli forces accuse [[Hezbollah]] of launching a [[Drone warfare|drone attack]] on its forces in the [[Ali al-Taher]] ridge of [[southern Lebanon|southern]] [[Lebanon]], in violation of [[2026 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire|the ceasefire]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2652721/amp (AFP via ''Arab News'')]

**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[Saudi Arabia in the 2026 Iran war]], [[Iraq in the 2026 Iran war]]
****The [[Saudi Arabian Armed Forces]] and [[United States Central Command]] (U.S. CENTCOM) launch strikes against [[Iran]]–backed militias in [[Iraq]] in response to [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|Iranian drone]] attacks against [[Oil reserves in Saudi Arabia|oil facilities]] in [[Saudi Arabia]]'s [[Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia|Eastern Province]]. [https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq/us-saudi-forces-strike-iran-backed-militias-in-iraq/ (''Iraqi News'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/saudi-arabia-says-drones-launched-iraq-targeting-oil-facilities-intercepted-2026-07-28/ (Reuters)]

***[[Egypt in the 2026 Iran war]]
****[[2026 Damietta drone strike]]
*****A drone strike targets the [[LNG storage tank|LNG storage]] [[Tanker (ship)|tanker]] ''Energos Winter'', which is leased by the [[Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company]], at the port of [[Damietta]], [[Egypt]]. Additionally, another vessel is also targeted. The group responsible for the strike is currently unknown. ****A senior officer in U.S. CENTCOM issues an internal email requesting troops to suggest "new creative and unconventional ways to pressure and punish Iran". [https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/03/politics/us-military-iran-war-troops-punish (CNN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Kenya Wildlife Service]] says preliminary tests indicated [[Cyanide poisoning|cyanide-contaminated]] tomatoes may have killed 15 elephants near [[Amboseli National Park]] over the past month, warning that [[Agriculture in Kenya|livestock grazing]] in the area could also be exposed. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/07/30/world/americas-emea/kenya-says-15-elephants-died-of-cyanide-poisoning-after-eating-tomatoes-from-nearby-farms/2394577 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
